intro.title: Project overview:
intro.body: As a Design System Product Designer, I led the evolution of PC Financial's design system across web and mobile banking experiences. My responsibility was to create a scalable foundation that enabled designers and engineers to build products more consistently, efficiently, and accessibly.
intro.bodyTwo: Beyond designing UI components, I worked across design, engineering, product, and QA teams to establish shared standards, scalable design tokens, reusable components, governance, and documentation that supported long-term system adoption.

challenge.title: Challenge
challenge.body: PC Financial was redesigning its digital banking experience, creating an opportunity to establish a new design system. The legacy system’s limited token scalability and fragmented component library presented challenges for maintaining consistency and scaling design across product experiences.
challenge.bodyTwo: The challenge wasn't just building a component library, but establishing a scalable foundation that teams could confidently adopt, maintain, and evolve.

cards.title: System Architecture
cards.body: Built a three-tier token architecture to support scalability and different themes

cards.title: Component Strategy & Collaboration
cards.body: Translated recurring product needs into reusable components and scalable patterns. Led weekly design system reviews to align teams on component behavior and promote reuse across product experiences.

cards.title: Design-to-Code and AI-enabled Workflow
cards.body: Established a repeatable token workflow from Figma Variables to code through JSON and Style Dictionary.

cards.title: Accessibility & Quality
cards.body: Validated elements and components accessibility against WCAG 2.2 and conducted visual QA.

tokensSubOne.title: From fragmented decisions to a scalable token architecture
tokensSubOne.body: I evaluated token structures and naming conventions against the needs of our web and mobile products, theme support, and long-term maintainability. Based on these findings, I established a token architecture built around four principles:

columns.title: Clear token hierarchy
columns.body: Created a three-tier token architecture to distinguish foundational values from their intended use.

columns.title: Consistent naming
columns.body: Created scalable naming conventions across foundations and components.

columns.title: Flexible theming
columns.body: Structured tokens to support light and dark themes across product experiences.

columns.title: Cross-platform scalability
columns.body: Structured tokens to support consistent design implementation and responsive experiences across web, iOS, and Android.

workflow.title: Connecting Design Tokens to Code
workflow.body: To extend the system beyond Figma, I worked with engineering to establish a repeatable workflow for transforming design tokens into platform-ready code.
list: Establish a scalable foundation for future token updates and adoption
Improve consistency between design tokens and production code to 100%
Support multi-platform delivery across web and mobile
workflow.bodyFour: Rather than treating tokens as Figma-only styles, this approach positioned them as a shared system asset that could move consistently from design into production code.

media.alt: Design token workflow from Figma to platform code

components.title: Building Reusable Components and Scalable Patterns
components.body: With a consistent token foundation in place, I focused on building reusable components that addressed recurring product needs across teams rather than solving isolated feature requests.
components.bodyTwo: I facilitated weekly design system reviews where designers evaluated new proposals, aligned on component behavior, and identified opportunities for reuse before implementation. Working with product managers and engineers, I helped turn recurring requirements into scalable components and patterns that could be shared across product experiences.

accessibility.title: Accessibility & Visual Quality Assurance
accessibility.body: I integrated accessibility into the design system from the foundation, validating design tokens and color contrast against WCAG 2.2 requirements. I documented usage guidelines and practical examples to help designers make accessible decisions from the start.
accessibility.bodyTwo: Beyond Figma, I partnered with engineers and QA to review production components, identify visual inconsistencies, and validate implementations against design specifications. This helped maintain design fidelity, address accessibility and UI issues early, and deliver more consistent, accessible experiences.

items.title: Token Structure
items.body: The 3-tiers token structure allows system to scale from design to code. Design tokens being adopted in all redesign project 100% with correct usage across design to code.

items.title: Product Delivery
items.body: Reusable components and repeatable design patterns helped streamline the redesign of Move money and Dashboard redesign, reducing design time from 2 weeks to 1 week.

items.title: Design Consistency
items.body: More collaborative workflow and clear documentation helped maintain a more consistent design experience across new designs for the Dashboard and Move Money pages for different platforms.
